instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Implement a pipelined module that converts 4-bit binary number 'BIN' to BCD format. 
The module should have one input (BIN) and two outputs (BCD_HIGH and BCD_LOW). BIN should be a binary number between 0 and 15. 
BCD_HIGH and BCD_LOW should represent the binary number in BCD format. Use pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
